title: Count
style: grainy found-footage still from a handheld camcorder and headlamps, deep uncharted limestone cave, harsh white headlamp beams cutting total darkness, wet glistening rock, VHS noise and lens flare, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 3. The camera recorded four heartbeats in Cave 3. There were three people. 🫀

Original fiction. Part 4 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: chalk arrows nobody drew led deeper into Cave 3, and the arrows pointing home were wiped away.
scenes.image: grainy headlamp still of white chalk arrows pointing down a dark cave tunnel

scenes.narration: Tape three. They're lost. They camp on a dry ledge and try to sleep. Nobody wants to be awake down here. Priya leaves the camera running, propped on a rock.
scenes.image: grainy static camcorder still of three sleeping bags on a rock ledge in a cave, one dim lantern

scenes.narration: For hours, nothing. Three sleeping bags. Three slow breaths. The drip of water.
scenes.image: grainy night-vision style still of a cave ledge, sleeping shapes in bags, water droplets glinting

scenes.narration: In 2024, investigators cleaned up that audio. They wanted to separate the sounds. They found something else. Something nobody could explain.
scenes.image: close-up of a vintage camcorder's microphone in a dark room, red record light glowing

scenes.narration: Heartbeats. The microphone was close enough to pick up the sleepers' hearts. Priya's, fast and light. Dev's, slow and steady. Lou's, with a little skip.
scenes.image: grainy close still of three sleeping cavers side by side, faces half lit by a dying lantern

scenes.narration: And a fourth. Deep. Slow. So slow it shouldn't keep anything alive.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still of the black cave beyond the ledge, a faint pale shape at the very edge of the light

scenes.narration: Beat by beat, through the night, it gets louder. And closer.
scenes.image: grainy still of the lantern on the ledge burning low, the darkness around the sleepers seeming to close in

scenes.narration: By four in the morning, the fourth heartbeat is louder than all the others. It's right next to the microphone.
scenes.image: extreme grainy close-up of the camcorder lens reflected in a wet rock surface, a dark shape looming behind

scenes.narration: Then the camera is picked up. The frame lifts off the rock, turns, and slowly pans across three sleeping friends.
scenes.image: grainy tilted camcorder still looking down at three sleeping cavers from above, motion blur

scenes.narration: Nobody in the shot is holding it.
scenes.image: grainy handheld still of three sleeping bags on a cave ledge, all three cavers clearly asleep inside them
